arabic_text: وَرَضِيَكُمْ خُلَفَاءَ فِي أَرْضِهِ وَحُجَجاً عَلَىٰ بَرِيَّتِهِ وَأَنْصَاراً لِدِينِهِ وَحَفَظَةً لِسِرِّهِ
transliteration: wa radiyakum khulafā'a fī ardhihi. wa ḥujajāan ʿalā barriyyatihī wa'anṣāran li dīnihī. waḥafazatan li sirrih.
english_text: and accepted you as vicegerents in His lands, arguments against His beings, supporters of His religion, keepers of His secret,

arabic_text: وَخَزَنَةً لِعِلْمِهِ وَمُسْتَوْدَعاً لِحِكْمَتِهِ وَتَرَاجِمَةً لِوَحْيِهِ وَأَرْكَاناً لِتَوْحِيدِهِ
transliteration: wa khazanatan li'ilmihi. wa mustawdaʿan lihikmatihi wa tarājimatan li-wahyih. waʾarkānan li-tawḥīdih.
english_text: hoarders of His knowledge, stores of His wisdom, interpreters of His revelation, pillars of the profession of His Oneness,

arabic_text: وَشُهَدَاءَ عَلَىٰ خَلْقِهِ وَأَعْلاَماً لِعِبَادِهِ وَمَنَاراً فِي بِلاَدِهِ وَأَدِلاَّءَ عَلَىٰ صِرَاطِهِ
transliteration: wa shuhadā'a ʿalā kh alqihi. wa aʿlāman liʿibādihi wa-manāran fī bilādih. wa adilā'a ʿalā ṣirāṭihī.
english_text: witnesses on His creatures, signs for His servants, torches in His lands, and directors to His path.

arabic_text: عَصَمَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلزَّلَلِ وَآمَنَكُمْ مِنَ ٱلْفِتَنِ وَطَهَّرَكُمْ مِنَ ٱلدَّنَسِ وَأَذْهَبَ عَنْكُمُ ٱلرِّجْسَ
transliteration: ʿasamakumu allah mina al-zalal. wa āmanakum min al-fitani. waṭahharakum mina al-danasi. wa 'adhhaba 'ankumu ar-rijas.
english_text: Allah has preserved you against slips, secured you against seditious matters, purified you from dirt, removed away from you uncleanness,

arabic_text: وَطَهَّرَكُمْ تَطْهِيراً
transliteration: waṭahharakum taṭhīran
english_text: and purified you with a thorough purifying.

arabic_text: فَعَظَّمْتُمْ جَلاَلَهُ وَأَكْبَرْتُمْ شَأْنَهُ وَمَجَّدْتُمْ كَرَمَهُ وَأَدَمْتُمْ ذِكْرَهُ
transliteration: faʿaz̧z̧amtum jalālahu wa akbar-tum sha'anahu. wa majjadtum karamahu. wa'adamtum dhikrah.
english_text: So, you have glorified His majesty, declared great His magnificence, glorified His nobility, perpetuated mentioning Him,

arabic_text: وَوَكَّدْتُمْ مِيثَاقَهُ وَأَحْكَمْتُمْ عَقْدَ طَاعَتِهِ وَنَصَحْتُمْ لَهُ فِي ٱلسِّرِّ وَٱلْعَلاَنِيَةِ وَدَعَوْتُمْ إِلَىٰ سَبِيلِهِ
transliteration: wa wakkadtum miithaqaahu. wa aḥkamtum ʿaqda ṭāʿatih. wa-naṣaḥtum lahū fī al-sirri wal-ʿalāniyah. wadaʿtum ilā sabīlihi.
english_text: consolidated His covenant, made firm your pledge of obedience to Him, acted sincerely to Him privately and publicly, called unto His way

arabic_text: بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَٱلْمَوْعِظَةِ ٱلْحَسَنَةِ وَبَذَلْتُمْ أَنْفُسَكُمْ فِي مَرْضَاتِهِ وَصَبَرْتُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا أَصَابَكُمْ فِي جَنْبِهِ وَأَقَمْتُمُ ٱلصَّلاَةَ
transliteration: bi-lḥikmati wa-l-mawʿiẓati al-ḥasanah. wabathaltum anfusakum fi marḍātihi wa ṣabartum ʿalā mā aṣābakum fī janbihi. wa-aqamtumu ṣ-ṣalāh.
english_text: with wisdom and fair admonition, sacrificed yourselves for the sake of attaining His pleasure, acted patiently towards what has befallen you for His sake, performed the prayers,

arabic_text: وَآتَيْتُمُ ٱلزَّكَاةَ وَأَمَرْتُمْ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَنَهَيْتُمْ عَنِ ٱلْمُنْكَرِ وَجَاهَدْتُمْ فِي ٱللَّهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهِ
transliteration: wa ʾātaytum al-zakāt. wa'martum bil-ma'ruf. wa nahaytum ʿani al-munkar. wa-jāhadtum fī llāhi ḥaqqahū jihādihī.
english_text: defrayed the poor-rate, enjoined the right, forbade the wrong, and strived in the way of Allah as exactly as striving should be

arabic_text: حَتَّىٰ أَعْلَنْتُمْ دَعْوَتَهُ وَبَيَّنْتُمْ فَرَائِضَهُ وَأَقَمْتُمْ حُدُودَهُ وَنَشَرْتُمْ شَرَائِعَ أَحْكَامِهِ
transliteration: ḥattā ʾaʿlantum daʿwatahu wa bayyantum fara'idahu. wa-aqamtum hudoodahu wa-nashartum sharāʾiʿa aḥkāmihi.
english_text: until you made known His call, rendered clear His obligations, executed His provisions, propagated for the enacted laws of Him,

arabic_text: وَسَنَنْتُمْ سُنَّتَهُ وَصِرْتُمْ فِي ذٰلِكَ مِنْهُ إِلَىٰ ٱلرِّضَا وَسَلَّمْتُمْ لَهُ ٱلْقَضَاءَ وَصَدَّقْتُمْ مِنْ رُسُلِهِ مَنْ مَضَىٰ
transliteration: wa sunantum sunnatahu. wa ṣirtum fī dhālika minhu ilā al-riḍā. wa sallamtu lahu al-qaḍā'a. waṣaddaqtum min rusulihi man maḍā.
english_text: acted out His rules, attained His pleasure through carrying out all these matters, surrendered to His will, and confirmed the truth of the past Messengers of Him.

arabic_text: فَٱلرَّاغِبُ عَنْكُمْ مَارِقٌ وَٱللاَّزِمُ لَكُمْ لاَحِقٌ وَٱلْمُقَصِّرُ فِي حَقِّكُمْ زَاهِقٌ
transliteration: fa al-rāghibu ʿankum māriqun. wa al-lāzimu lakum lāḥiqun wa al-muqaṣṣiru fī ḥaqqikum zāhiqun.
english_text: Therefore, whoever forsakes you is apostate, whoever adheres to you will attain the destination, and whoever fails to carry out the duties towards you will perish.

arabic_text: وَٱلْحَقُّ مَعَكُمْ وَفيكُمْ وَمِنْكُمْ وَإِلَيْكُمْ
transliteration: wal-ḥaqqu maʿakum wa fīkum wamin-kum wa-ilaykum.
english_text: Verily, the truth is always with you, amid you, from you, and to you.

arabic_text: وَأَنْتُمْ أَهْلُهُ وَمَعْدِنُهُ
transliteration: wa antum ahluhu wa ma'dinuhu.
english_text: You are the people and the core of it (i.e. the truth).

arabic_text: وَمِيرَاثُ ٱلنُّبُوَّةِ عِنْدَكُمْ
transliteration: wa-mīrāthu al-nubuwwati ʿindakum
english_text: The inheritance of Prophethood is with you.

arabic_text: وَإِيَابُ ٱلْخَلْقِ إِلَيْكُمْ
transliteration: wa-iyaabu al-khalqi ilaykum.
english_text: The ultimate destination of the creatures is to you.

arabic_text: وَحِسَابُهُمْ عَلَيْكُمْ
transliteration: waḥisābuhum ʿalaykum.
english_text: Calling them to account is your mission.

arabic_text: وَفَصْلُ ٱلْخِطَابِ عِنْدَكُمْ
transliteration: wafaslul-khitabi 'indakum.
english_text: Decisive speech is with you.

arabic_text: وَآيَاتُ ٱللَّهِ لَدَيْكُمْ
transliteration: wa āyātu l-lāhi ladaykum.
english_text: The verses of Allah is in your possession.

arabic_text: وَعَزَائِمُهُ فِيكُمْ
transliteration: wa ʿazāʾimu-hu fīkum.
english_text: His unavoidable decrees rely upon you.

arabic_text: وَنُورُهُ وَبُرْهَانُهُ عِنْدَكُمْ
transliteration: wa nuruhu wa burhanuhu ʿindakum.
english_text: His light and proof are with you.

arabic_text: وَأَمْرُهُ إِلَيْكُمْ
transliteration: wa amruhu ilaykum.
english_text: His authority is to you.

arabic_text: مَنْ وَالاَكُمْ فَقَدْ وَالَىٰ ٱللَّهَ وَمَنْ عَادَاكُمْ فَقَدْ عَادَىٰ ٱللَّهَ وَمَنْ أَحَبَّكُمْ فَقَدْ أَحَبَّ ٱللَّهَ وَمَنْ أَبْغَضَكُمْ فَقَدْ أَبْغَضَ ٱللَّهَ
transliteration: man wālākum faqad wālā llāh. wa-man ʿādākum faqad ʿādā allāh. wa man aḥabbakum faqad aḥabballah. wa-man abghadakum faqad abghad allāh.
english_text: Whoever declares loyalty to you has in fact declared loyalty to Allah, whoever shows enmity towards you has in fact shown enmity towards Allah, whoever loves you has in fact loved Allah, whoever hates you has in fact hated Allah,

arabic_text: وَمَنِ ٱعْتَصَمَ بِكُمْ فَقَدِ ٱعْتَصَمَ بِٱللَّهِ
transliteration: wa mani ʿtaṣama bikum faqadi ʿtaṣama billāh.
english_text: and whoever holds fast to you has in fact held fast to Allah.

arabic_text: أَنْتُمُ ٱلصِّرَاطُ ٱلْأَقْوَمُ وَشُهَدَاءُ دَارِ ٱلْفَنَاءِ وَشُفَعَاءُ دَارِ ٱلْبَقَاءِ وَٱلرَّحْمَةُ ٱلْمَوْصُولَةُ
transliteration: antum al-ṣirāṭ al-aqwam. wa shuhadā'u dār al-fanāʾ. wa shufaʿā'u dār al-baqā'ā. wa al-raḥmah al-mawṣūlah.
english_text: You are the most straight path,( ) the witnesses of this abode of extinction, the intercessors in the abode of permanence, the connected mercy,

arabic_text: وَٱلآيَةُ ٱلْمَخْزُونَةُ وَٱلْأَمَانَةُ ٱلْمَحْفُوظَةُ وَٱلْبَابُ ٱلْمُبْتَلَىٰ بِهِ ٱلنَّاسُ
transliteration: wa al-āyah al-makhzūnah wal-amānatu al-maḥfūẓah wal-bābu al-mubtalā bihi an-nāsu.
english_text: the stored sign, the safeguarded deposit, and the door with which people are put to test.

arabic_text: مَنْ أَتَاكُمْ نَجَا وَمَنْ لَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ هَلَكَ
transliteration: man ataakum najā. wa-man lam ya'tikum halak.
english_text: Whoever comes to will have been saved but whoever refrains from joining you will have perished.

arabic_text: إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ تَدْعُونَ وَعَلَيْهِ تَدُلُّونَ وَبِهِ تُؤْمِنُونَ وَلَهُ تُسَلِّمُونَ
transliteration: 'ilā allāhi tad'ūn. wa ʿalayhi tadullūn wa bihi tuʾminūn. wa lahu tusallimūn.
english_text: To Allah do you invite people, towards him do you show the way, in Him do you believe, to Him do you submit,

arabic_text: وَبِأَمْرِهِ تَعْمَلُونَ وَإِلَىٰ سَبِيلِهِ تُرْشِدُونَ وَبِقَوْلِهِ تَحْكُمُونَ
transliteration: wa bi-amrihi taʿmaloon. wa-ilā sabīlihi turshidūn. wa biqawlihi taḥkumūn
english_text: upon His command do you act, to His path do you direct, and according to His saying do you judge.

arabic_text: سَعَدَ مَنْ وَالاَكُمْ وَهَلَكَ مَنْ عَادَاكُمْ وَخَابَ مَنْ جَحَدَكُمْ وَضَلَّ مَنْ فَارَقَكُمْ
transliteration: saʿada man wālākum. wa halaka man ʿadākum. wa-khaba man jaḥadakum. waḍalla man fāraqakum.
english_text: Happy is he who is loyal to you, desolate is he who forsakes you, disappointed is he who denies you, straying off is he who separates himself from you,
